context_branches.branch_paraphrase: PARKMEMO is the earlier filled memo, although prose calls it a letter. The initial editing changes are not specified; a later bounded execution must declare them and its saved revision, not invent evidence.

From the exit question, Yes exits,No clears andF1 keeps the document/caret; within margins, F7 commits whileF1 backs out without inserting a margin owner in this tested context. Source says most cases, not a universal cancel law.

The restored centered title includes its code; deletion of To/Date begins on Bold owners. Retain up to3 deletions, preview at current caret, cancel preview and restore at correct gaps. Up/Down are alternatives to PreviousDeletion cycling.
The learner may experiment further, but no finite key sequence is supplied. Keep an unresolved optional exercise; do not fabricate a completed all-context Cancel corpus.

Index letters, template, function-key reference topics and context-sensitive printer Help are distinct states. Topic keystrokes while in Help must not edit the document. Enter versus Space exits and repeatedF7 menu returns need exact focus/caret checks.
Step8 asks the learner to find the appropriate key rather than spelling it out. Preserve actual template/index mapping as a required source/interface witness; no guessed binding is added here.
Two-drive setup needs WordPerfect1 disk inB for Help, then Learn disk restored. WPHELP.FIL has a registered fingerprint; this is not a current private availability or exact Help-content claim.

Capture real reference version/date and conditional registration data, not the1989 example header. WBC51 PDF2 correction573 qualifies the registration field; correction1636 removes the stray inch quote in margin step11.

Reference sections/index, optional tutorial and historical support/publications are documentary context. Keep reproducibility/hardware-description advice; do not contact anyone, mail registration, assert current services or implement old institutions. Tutorial installation/execution remains unrun and is not expanded here.

MUSICBOX.WKB is the original rough draft; subsequent MUSICBOX is a distinct learner-saved output. Source defines enter as type then Enter. Preserve extension, source identity, working directory and selected printer.

Delete removes at caret, Backspace before it; restore then remove word plus preceding space. Optional whole-letter scrolling must return to the prescribed paragraph. Source24visible rows/25th status is a declared display context, not a modern universal terminal size.

The phrase may be deleted characterwise as explanatory alternative; the numbered route deletes3 words. Ctrl-End removes line text but leaves HRt; subsequent Delete removes that owner. Preserve spacing, history and unrelated code boundaries.

Declare8.5x11in/1in default margins and printer metrics. Status positions include margins. Added blank lines move text through a soft boundary; HardPage remains attached to its source gap. The source explicitly allows correcting a misplaced hard break via Backspace then reinsertion.

The1989 source describes30-minute backup, possible wait notice and removal on exit, while explicit Save preserves named work and continues editing. This is source evidence forS1/S2 follow-up, not modern autosave equivalence or observed March1992 behavior; later recovery section is referenced but not expanded here.

Choose top-center every page and inspect the owner at the beginning before other text/codes; source warns late page-format placement begins on a later page. Other diagram positions/alternating-page choices/None are unselected source leads; no unseen coordinate mapping is guessed.

SuppressPageNumber is this-page-only and leaves all-page numbering for following pages. Other pictured options include suppress all/headers/footers, bottom-center and individualHeader/FooterA/B; these remain unexecuted leads.

Normal editing lacks printed page number; preview page1 suppression and page2 number are distinct. Source reserves two number/spacing lines.100percent/Home arrows pan the view, while doubleHome navigates document; do not conflate these states.

Retrieving teaching input selects WorkbookPrinter; printing requires an actual installed printer. Save before print, choose own definition, inspect selection, and save that association for later retrieval. This requires real declared PRS/metrics and native/print evidence, not a metadata-only claim.
